info.name: The Man with the Iron Hammer

descriptions.notStarted: The word iron hammer written on the wall at #p2103001#... I think it's pointing at someone. I think there's only one person in #m260000000# carrying an iron hammer... Was his name #p2101003#?
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101003# is also the member of the Sand Bandits. #p2101003# told me only the strongest deserve to be a member, and that I had to prove him my worth. I was told to eliminate the ferocious #r#o2100105##k... #o2100105#? I'll finish it right off the spot!\n\n#o2100105# #r#a39311##k
descriptions.completed: I eliminated #o2100105#, but #p2101003# said that I am still short of becoming the member of the Sand Bandits, and that I still won't be accepted as one.
